zhCN.summary: 改进会话发送、技能管理和导航，修复确认事项及自动更新重启提示。
changes: 修正用户消息与回复的显示顺序，执行中的补充需求可在输入框上方排队并进行引导。
修复上下文面板的关闭交互，并简化会话侧栏展示。
未选择项目也能查看通用技能，项目技能按所属项目分组展示。
统一页面返回与前进导航，保留会话及输入草稿。
优化确认事项与历史详情，保护反馈草稿并隔离操作错误。
修复计划交接、子 Agent 恢复与长任务租约维护问题。
修复安装包中 AHO 内置技能的读取路径，恢复已安装应用的技能发现和任务发送。
修复更新重启阶段因连接关闭而出现的错误失败提示。
本版本会升级项目数据，旧版不能直接读取升级后的数据。

enUS.summary: Improved conversation input, skill management and navigation, with fixes for confirmations and update restart notices.
changes: Corrected message ordering, with queued follow-up requests and guidance above the composer during active tasks.
Fixed context panel dismissal and simplified the conversation sidebar.
Global skills are available without selecting a project, with project skills grouped by project.
Unified Back and Forward navigation while preserving conversations and drafts.
Improved confirmation details and history, with protected feedback drafts and scoped action errors.
Fixed planning handoffs, child Agent recovery and lease renewal for long-running tasks.
Fixed access to bundled AHO skills in installed builds, restoring skill discovery and task submission.
Fixed false update failure notices caused by connection closure during restart.
This version upgrades project data; older builds cannot directly open the upgraded data.
